confirm_port_change.title: Change port to {new_port}?
confirm_port_change.description:
Changing the port renames the entity IDs of this panel's zone sensors. For example, the entity ID of "{name}" will change from `{old_entity_id}` to `{new_entity_id}`.

Update any automations, scripts or dashboards that use these entity IDs. The entities keep their history. To keep port {old_port}, close this dialog.
